subject.title: fix(azure): responses model aliases route correctly

question: Should trusted manifest alias metadata plus configured Azure endpoint/model surface determine the provider and transport owner, while unconditional OpenAI model suppression overrides even an explicit Azure model row?
rationale: This rule controls which credential, endpoint, and provider runtime receive a model request and establishes a reusable trust policy for bundled, configured, workspace, and external plugin alias claims; tests can prove consistency but cannot choose the permanent ownership contract.

options.title: Accept the fail-closed owner rule
options.body: Approve the branch’s precedence contract, require disposition of the two failing exact-head checks, and merge after the final head is validated.

options.title: Move ownership into provider hooks
options.body: Pause this PR and redesign alias ownership as a provider-plugin runtime hook if maintainers do not want core manifest metadata arbitrating credentials and transport.

options.title: Narrow to Azure only
options.body: Replace the generic alias-owner policy with a tightly scoped Azure repair, accepting less reuse but reducing the cross-plugin trust surface.

recommendation.title: Accept the fail-closed owner rule
recommendation.body: Approve the branch’s precedence contract, require disposition of the two failing exact-head checks, and merge after the final head is validated.
